caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, stylized object on a plain, beige background. The primary shape resembles a shield or bib with a wide, rounded bottom that narrows at the neck and then flares out into a pointed top. The object is filled with a bright red color and is bordered by a scalloped edge in shades of white and brown. The central section of the object is decorated with white bead-like motifs forming floral and leafy patterns, with a large flower at both the bottom and the top portions, flanked by smaller leaf shapes. In the lower half of the object, there is a white bird facing to the right, surrounded by leaf and flower patterns. The composition is centered, and the design elements are evenly distributed within the red shape.
title: Watch Holder
